name: Intent card renders the seeded PR intent and the out-of-scope disclosure
description: L03 (intent layer). On PR #482's detail page the Intent card (rendered above the tabs, so it's visible regardless of the active tab) shows the seeded pr_intent row: the derived intent sentence, a 'Medium confidence' chip, a 'used' source ('Changed files') and an 'unavailable' source with its ref ('Linked issue · #412'), plus the 'Missing context' gap text that unavailable source triggers. Switching to the Agent runs tab then shows the seeded out-of-scope finding (the WARNING 'N+1 query in user list endpoint', seeded with in_scope: false) surfaced in the always-visible 'Outside stated scope' strip and counted in the FindingsPanel's scope disclosure. Entirely seeded data (server/src/db/seed.ts) — no LLM call, no API key, and the Re-derive button is never clicked.
